When was Nora Roberts Born? How old is Nora Roberts?

Nora Roberts was born on October 10th, 1950. Nora Roberts is currently 76 years old.

Where was Nora Roberts Born?

Nora Roberts was born in Silver Spring, Maryland, United States and is American.

What was the first book Nora Roberts wrote?

The first book written by Nora Roberts was Irish Thoroughbred, published in 1981.

What was the most recent book Nora Roberts wrote?

Her most recently released work was Fury in Death on September 8th, 2026.

What is the most popular book by Nora Roberts?

Based on the number of readers on Book Notification, the most popular Nora Roberts book is Naked in Death. Here are her most popular books and their average ratings:

  2. Glory in Death (8.75)

  4. Rapture in Death (8.68)

What genres does Nora Roberts Write?

Nora Roberts primarily writes in the Mystery, Romance, Romantasy, and Thriller genres. Her work includes sub-genres such as Contemporary Romance, Crime Thriller, and Romantic Suspense.

Are there upcoming new books by Nora Roberts?

Nora Roberts has three new books coming out: Birth of the Witch will be released on November 17th, 2026. Perfect in Death will be released on February 2nd, 2027. The Missing will be released on May 25th, 2027

Click and we will keep you updated on these via e-mail, and about any new books Nora Roberts announces in the future.
